header.title: JIRA Integration
header.description: Set up JIRA integration to sync test cases from JIRA tickets and run them with Endorphin AI.

overview.title: Overview
items: Automatically fetch test cases from JIRA tickets
Convert JIRA tickets written in a special format into executable tests
Generate test data using AI
Run JIRA-synced tests alongside your regular tests
Track raw JIRA data for auditing and debugging

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
items: JIRA Cloud account with API access
JIRA project with test case tickets
Node.js 16+ and Endorphin AI installed

ticketFormat.title: Step 3: JIRA Ticket Format
ticketFormat.description: Create JIRA tickets with one of the following special formats in the ticket description.

users.title: @USERS section
items: @USERS [@ROLE1, @ROLE2, @ROLE3] declares the user roles for the test
Supports descriptive role names like @ADMIN, @SELLER, @USER, @MANAGER
Role names are case-insensitive and converted to lowercase (for example, @ADMIN becomes admin)
Special characters are removed (for example, @USER-BUYER becomes userbuyer)
Each role must have a corresponding @ROLE.PHASE1 section in @STEPS

data.title: @DATA section
items: @DATA('prompt') is the AI prompt for generating test data
List the field definitions one per line, in the form fieldname: description of what this field should contain
Supports any field names you need
Use role-specific field names for multi-user tests (for example, admin_email, seller_email)

steps.title: @STEPS section
items: Contains all test execution phases
Role-based (recommended): @ADMIN.PHASE1, @SELLER.PHASE1. Uses the declared role names
Legacy: @USER1, @USER.PHASE1, @USER1.PHASE1. Uses numeric user identifiers

userRole.title: User/Role section
items: Holds the test steps to execute for each user or role
Use ${data.fieldname} to reference generated data
Each line is a test instruction
Steps execute in parallel for multi-user tests

roleBased.title: Role-Based Multi-User Format
roleBased.description: For tests with multiple users running in parallel using descriptive role names:
results: users: ['admin', 'customer'], two browser sessions with meaningful role names
A tasks object with the keys admin.phase1 and customer.phase1
Each role executes its phase in parallel

legacy.title: Legacy Multi-User Format
legacy.description: For backward compatibility, the numeric format still works:
results: A tasks object with the keys user1.phase1 and user2.phase1
Each user executes their phase in parallel

multiPhase.title: Single-User Multi-Phase Tests
multiPhase.description: For tests with one user going through multiple phases:
results: All phases combined into sequential steps

syncOnly.title: Sync Only (No Test Execution)
syncOnly.description: Currently, JIRA sync is integrated with test execution. To sync without running tests, run a sync and then cancel the test execution.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.description: Common issues and how to fix them

authFailed.title: Authentication Failed
authFailed.solution: Check your JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN. Regenerate the API token if needed.

noTickets.title: No Tickets Found
solutions: Verify that JIRA_PROJECT_ID and JIRA_ISSUE_TYPE_ID are correct
Check that the tickets have the specified label (JIRA_LABEL)
Ensure tickets exist in the project

invalidFormat.title: Invalid Ticket Format
invalidFormat.solution: Ensure your JIRA ticket description follows the required format with @DATA, @STEPS, and @USER.PHASE1 sections.

fieldParsing.title: Field Parsing Issues
solutions: Ensure each field is on a separate line in the @DATA section
Avoid special characters in field names

rawData.title: Checking Raw Data
rawData.description: Inspect the raw JIRA data in the jira-raw/ folder to debug ticket format issues.

naming.title: Consistent Naming
items: Use descriptive field names (for example, user_email instead of email1)
Follow consistent naming patterns across tickets

descriptions.title: Clear Descriptions
items: Write clear field descriptions for better AI data generation
Be specific about data requirements (for example, "valid email address for testing")

organization.title: Test Organization
items: Use consistent labels for grouping related test tickets
Include ticket IDs in test names for easy tracking

versionControl.title: Version Control
items: Add jira-raw/ to .gitignore if the data contains sensitive information
Include generated test files in version control for review

regularSync.title: Regular Sync
items: Run JIRA sync regularly to get the latest ticket updates
Review generated tests before important test runs

security.title: Security Considerations
items: Store API tokens securely (use the .env file, not code)
Add .env to .gitignore to prevent credential exposure
Rotate JIRA API tokens regularly
Review generated test data for sensitive information
